events.title: The Martyrs of Gorkum
events.shortBlurb: Nineteen priests and religious were hanged in Holland for their faith in the Eucharist and the papacy…
body: During the religious wars in the Low Countries, nineteen Catholic clergy — Franciscans, secular priests, and others — were seized at Gorkum by Calvinist forces and pressed to renounce their belief in the Real Presence of Christ in the Eucharist and the primacy of the pope. They refused.
On the ninth of July 1572 they were hanged in a turf shed at Brielle. Their constancy was long remembered in the Netherlands, and they were canonized by Pope Pius IX in 1867.
